Order Sheet
11/11/2024
Mr. Sudhir Kumar Sahu, counsel for the appellant.
Ms. Neeta Tulsani Thawani, Panel Lawyer for the State.
Heard on I.A. No. 01/2024 which is an application filed under Section 430of BNSS 2023 for suspension of the sentence and grant of bail.

This criminal appeal has been filed being aggrieved by the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 29- 8-2024 (Annexure - A/1) passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge Second Fast Track Special Judge (POCSO Ac), Raipur (C.G.) in Special Sessions Trial No. 16 of 2019 whereby the appellant has been convicted and sentenced in the following manner:-
 Conviction Sentence  U/s 363 of IPC : R.I. for 2 years and fine of Rs. 1,000/- in  default of payment of fine amount 1  month additional R.I.
 Under Section R.I. for 5 years and fine of Rs. 1,000/- in  366 of IPC default of payment of fine amount 1  month additional R.I.
 Under Section R.I. for 10 years and fine of Rs. 2,000/-
 376(2) of IPC in default of payment of fine amount 1  month additional R.I.
The learned counsel for the appellant would submit that the appellant was on bail during trial, he has deposited the fine amount which is imposed by the learned trial Court.

sentences.text:
He would further submit that the disposal of criminal appeal is likely to take long time,
therefore, he would pray for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The State has filed its reply wherein it has been stated that the appellant committed heinous offence of abducting minor girl and then committed sexual assault and rape with her forcibly and the said charges have been proved by the prosecution and even if the appellant has married with the victim/girl, it cannot be compounded, therefore, the appellant is not entitled for grant of bail.
In pursuance of the notice issued to the victim, victim has appeared before this Court and raised no objection in granting suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused record of the trial Court Considering the submissions made by the parties, considering the statement of the Doctor who has not given definite opinion regarding commission of rape and also considering the fact that the marriage between the appellant and victim girl was solemnized on 23-11-2020 which has been registered by the Registrar of Marriage, Raipur Municipal Corporation, Raipur and there is likelihood of delay in final hearing of this criminal appeal
, I am inclined to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

Accordingly, I.A. No. 01/2024 which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail,
is allowed and it is directed that the jail sentence imposed upon the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this criminal appeal and he shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry on 15.01.2025 and thereafter appear before the trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given to him by RAVVA SATYANARAYANA RAJU the said Court till disposal of this criminal appeal.
List this case on due course for final hearing.

Sd/-
 Sd SDC Raju (Narendra Kumar Vyas)
